idea.idea: The public AI link leak: Why sharing chat logs is exposing business numbers
idea.angle: Security audits found small business revenue sheets and internal proposals exposed via shared chat links; here is how to secure your team's AI history.
idea.audience_problem: Small business teams frequently click 'Share Chat' to send AI-generated proposals to clients, inadvertently making sensitive company figures publicly searchable.

hooks: Are your AI chat links exposing your business data?
Stop sharing private business data via AI chat links
How your AI-generated quotes might be public knowledge
piece.hook_reason: It directly addresses the fear of data exposure while being specific to the audience's habit of sharing AI-generated outputs.

slides.title: Are your AI chat links exposing your business data?
slides.subtitle: Publicly shared AI logs can leak sensitive internal revenue and loan documents.

slides.title: The hidden risk
slides.body: When you click 'Share' to send an AI-generated proposal to a client, the URL sometimes includes the chat title and gets written into public DNS registries.

slides.title: Data visibility
slides.myth: Shared AI links are private to the recipient.
slides.fact: Researchers found company revenue reviews and loan applications indexed and findable via public links.

slides.title: Audit your AI links
slides.body: Check these steps to secure your team's workspace today.
items: Audit previous shared AI conversation links
Avoid pasting internal revenue data into chat
Check permissions before clicking any share button
Delete old shared links if they contain sensitive text
Review new privacy updates from your AI provider

slides.title: A note on security
slides.quote: Anyone visiting the old link will see a note asking them to get the new one from you.

slides.title: Final safety rules
items: Assume shared links are publicly searchable
Never include bank or internal tax data
Always verify who can access shared URLs
Treat AI chat as a public whiteboard

piece.caption: Are your business proposals and revenue reports visible to anyone with a search engine? Small business owners often use 'Share' links to send AI-generated quotes to clients, but some AI platforms accidentally made these chat logs publicly searchable. Researchers recently found private loan applications and internal revenue reviews indexed online. Before you hit share on your next AI chat, remove any sensitive financial figures or client names. Treat every shared AI link as if it were a public notice board. Have you checked your shared AI chat history lately? #BusinessSecurity #SmallBusinessIndia #DataPrivacy #AITips #BusinessOwner
